'''Mabari script''' was a [[writing]] system used by the [[Mabari/Legends|Mabari]], an ancient order of [[Soldier/Legends|warrior-knights]] from<ref name="Wesell">{{GamerCite|10|Zam Wesell: Clawdite Assassin}}</ref> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]], the homeworld of the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] species.<ref name="Sanbra">{{GamerCite|10|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Clawdites}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The writing on the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]'s [[Armor/Legends|armor]] was first identified as Mabari inscriptions in ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', published on [[May 23]], [[2002]].<ref name="AOTCVD" />
